xmldoc.short_description: Returns the include directories required to build a native nflow block plugin.

param_output_item.param_description: a cell array of include directory paths: the nflow_blocks SDK headers followed by the Nelson SDK include directories.

description.p: C = dlgetnflowincludes() returns the include directories needed to build a native nflow block plugin.

The result lists the nflow_blocks public headers (BlockPlugin.h, SimEngineTypes.hpp, and others), then the Nelson SDK include directories. The Nelson directories provide nlohmann/json.hpp, which is included by SimEngineTypes.hpp.
The paths are resolved whether Nelson runs from its source tree or from an installation.
This function is typically passed to dlgeneratemake.
